high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a text-based informational slide or document. The background is white, and the text is black, making it easy to read. There are no people, objects, or visual elements other than the text itself. The text provides information about an incident involving Maggi noodles. It states that Maggi was banned across the country for six months in June 2015 due to allegations that the product contained chemicals beyond prescribed limits. As a result, the company had to recall and destroy 38,000 tonnes of Maggi noodles from millions of retail shelves.
